Is Francis just the bishop of Rome or is he still the successor of Peter and the representative of Christ? A change in the Pontifical Yearbook (Orig: Annuario Pontificio 2020 - https://www.vaticanum.com/en/pontifical-yearbook-2020-orig-annuario-pontificio-2020) raises questions.

Unlike in previous editions of the Pontifical Yearbook, the various titles of the Pope in the 2020 edition are no longer listed above the name of the incumbent, Jorge Mario Bergoglio.

Instead, they are on the corresponding page, delimited and overwritten: «Titoli storici», «historical title». These are: "Deputy of Jesus Christ, successor of the Prince of the Apostles, Pontifex maximus of the universal church, primate of Italy, archbishop and metropolitan of the province of Rome, sovereign of the state of the Vatican City, servant of the servant of God". - On the page in front is: "Francis, Bishop of Rome".

"That irritates me a bit," admits the church historian Hubert Wolf from Münster when asked by the German Catholic News Agency.
